Zinc 
• Cellular 
metabolism,

immune

macular

dL 
• Deficiency 
interrupts the

adults, deficiency 
can cause delays in 
wound healing and

and psychological 
function. 
• Excessive intake can 
cause nausea, 
dizziness, 
headaches, gastric 
distress, vomiting, 
and loss of appetite. 
• Doses of 50 mg or 
more from 
supplements or

denture adhesive 
creams containing 
zinc can interfere 
with copper 
absorption, reduce 
immune function, 
and lower high-
density lipoprotein 
cholesterol levels. 
• High doses from 
supplements (142 
mg/day) interfere 
with magnesium 
absorption. 
• 8–12 mg/day 
• Food sources: 
meat, fish, and 
seafood (oysters 
contain the most 
zinc of all foods); 
other foods such 
as eggs, dairy, 
beans, nuts, and 
whole grains 
contain zinc but 
are not fully 
metabolized.
